title: Vector Service: PII Sanitization, Retention Policy, and Audit Trails for Embeddings & Reranking
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Reduce PII exposure and provide auditable, configurable logging and retention controls for the embeddings and reranking endpoints without significantly degrading latency or quality. Scope includes (1) runtime redaction/sanitization of logs and telemetry, (2) hashed audit traces for debugging, (3) per-org retention configuration and enforcement, (4) secure export of audit events to customer-managed sinks, and (5) telemetry gating in high-QPS paths to preserve latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime logging must not contain raw request text for 'redacted' orgs/default: raw text removed and replaced by deterministic HMAC-hash + metadata
Configurable retention per org with default 30 days; enforcement job deletes expired entries and emits retention audit events
Audit events include: timestamp, model_id, route, request_hash (HMAC), user/org id, redaction_status, reranker_score_stats; do NOT include raw input or embeddings
Opt-in enterprise flow allows storing encrypted raw inputs for up to N days when customer provides KMS; UI + API controls must reflect opt-in
End-to-end tests demonstrate <5% tail-latency increase for embeddings/rerank endpoints under production traffic patterns when logging is enabled
Migration plan for existing logs: ensure legacy telemetry older than 90 days is expired or marked in compliance export
Audit-sink integration with S3/Cloud Storage and syslog-ready audit stream; customers can request full-audit export under contract
risk_and_tradeoffs: Storing hashes instead of raw text improves privacy but makes reproduction of some QA bugs harder; we provide on-demand replay only with customer's KMS consent
Adding logging in hot-paths may impact tail latency; mitigate by sampling, async buffering, and a controlled canary rollout
Per-org retention adds metadata complexity and GC overhead; we'll batch deletes and tombstone entries to avoid blocking serving threads
design_decisions: Use HMAC-SHA256 with per-org key stored in KMS to compute request_hash. We store only the first 16 hex chars of the HMAC to balance traceability and privacy.
Default logging mode = 'redacted' (no raw inputs persisted). Admins can enable 'encrypted_raw' when they provide a KMS key and sign agreement.
Telemetry pipeline will emit two event classes: lightweight audit events (always) and optional detailed events (encrypted, enterprise-only).
Retention enforcement implemented as a distributed GC job (daily sweep) that tombstones rows and finally removes vectors after TTL to avoid hot deletes.
implementation_notes: Server-side: add logging middleware for embeddings/rerank endpoints with early redaction; expose API flag log_mode (redacted|hashed|encrypted_raw) via per-org config
Storage: add 'audit_events' table with indexed 'expiry_ts' and 'request_hash' (store truncated hex) and a separate 'encrypted_payloads' bucket for enterprise raw inputs
Security: integrate per-org KMS keys from Private deployment key registry; rotate HMAC keys quarterly and expose rotation metadata in audit events
Observability: add cost/latency metrics for logging middleware; add alerts for GC backlog and audit export failures
comments: 2026-02-18 - Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after sync with PM and Security. Problem statement confirmed: multiple customers asked for stronger PII controls for vector workloads.
2026-02-23 - Liam Patel: Spike complete. Measured overhead: naive sync logging added ~12% p99; async batching reduced that to ~3% p99. Recommendation: async buffering + sampling for public tenants.

2026-02-28 - Security Review (Ravi Shah): Prefer HMAC approach over hashing-only to avoid dictionary attacks. Recommends truncation and per-org keys. Also recommends storing key-rotation metadata. Marking security_review_required=true.
2026-03-03 - Design review: Decided on three-tier logging modes and enterprise KMS opt-in. UX team requested an admin toggle in Console and an audit export view.
2026-03-06 - PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521 - adds audit_events table schema and logging middleware stub. Needs load-testing and migration plan.

2026-03-09 - Load test results: with async batch size=50 and sampling=1% for hosted tier, p99 increases by 2.8% on embeddings endpoint; rerank p99 increases by 3.4% under 95th percentile QPS patterns.
2026-03-11 - PM (Nora Malik): Add acceptance criteria for UI visibility and opt-in flows. Confirmed default retention 30 days and enterprise max 365 days in contract.
2026-03-12 - Liam Patel: Implemented GC tombstone job prototype and integration test. Next: secure export and canary rollout plan.
notes_for_qa: Create synthetic PII corpus and validate that 'redacted' orgs never persist raw text in DB or object storage
Verify HMAC collision rate on truncated 16-hex prefix is acceptably low for our tenant count
Validate retention GC by setting short TTL in staging and asserting deletion and audit events are emitted
